explication: AfterTouch is a local SoundTouch cloud replacement, accompanied by LAN control tools and a Go client library. The main workflow is an owner using the web UI to configure or manage speakers; the service exposes management APIs, performs setup and cloud-service emulation, and supports speaker control and discovery. The README documents capabilities beyond the sampled excerpts, including migration, redirects, backups, and standalone player operation. Edges for unsampled service internals are limited to documented relationships; dashed edges indicate connections not verified in the excerpts.
